name: Billboard
description: A Billboard is a 2D Material that will be rendered always facing the camera.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Half size of the Billboard, X is the width and Y the height (before 1.166.0 they were swapped). In units, or in screen space if size_in_screen_space is true

parameters.name: size_in_screen_space
parameters.description: Size is in Screen or World Space
